# Mizan (formerly RTL Arena)

> A reproducible benchmark of how well AI coding tools handle Arabic / right-to-left.

Mizan (Arabic ميزان, "the scale"; part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co) scores AI coding tools — Cursor,
Claude, Copilot, v0, Lovable — on right-to-left / Arabic UI. Each tool is given the same 15 prompts;
its output is graded automatically by the Otto graders (miraat + kashida + daleel). Scoring is gated
(no Arabic → 0), per-prompt normalized, and clamped, so a tool cannot win by emitting less or empty
code. The "RTL" academic name collision (hardware register-transfer-level) means the right-to-left
correctness benchmark space is otherwise unclaimed.

## Use it
- Prompts + scorer: `npx github:Otto-OttoSpace/mizan`
- Grade outputs: `node score.js outputs`
- Contribute a tool's results via PR.

Links: https://github.com/Otto-OttoSpace/mizan · https://dev.ottospace.co
